name: Otherwordly Goods Store
source:
Three friends find a peculiar store while trick-or-treating.

[From [url=https://punniiyan.itch.io/otherwordly-goods-store]Itch.io[/url]]

The game is privated, but if for some reason you wish to play this, the password is "halloween"
translation:
三个好朋友在万圣节“不给糖就捣蛋”的路上，偶然发现了一家古怪的店铺。

[摘自[url=https://punniiyan.itch.io/otherwordly-goods-store]itch.io[/url]]

本作目前已设为私密状态；但倘若你出于某种原因想要游玩，访问密码为“halloween”。
